subject: Request: Trial top-up & timebox extension due to connector schema blocker
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenluma.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC blocked by connector schema mismatch — can we extend trial/top-up?

Hi Neha,

Quick update from our side — the data connector the engineering team built against your sandbox is hitting a schema mismatch when the streaming payload arrives. Our backend team traced it to an unexpected top-level array in the events payload; that mismatch is cascading into the ingestion job and blocking our demo work.

We were planning the demo for next Monday but without this fix we won't be able to complete the integration tests or evaluate throughput. Given the delay, can Redwood approve a one-time trial top-up (extra credits) and extend our trial window by two weeks? Our CTO wants to keep momentum but we need runway to finish the connector fix and validate performance.

I've attached the connector error log and a short snippet from our engineer. Happy to jump on a call.

Best,
Alex
Product Lead — GreenLuma

Attachment: connector-error-log.txt (text)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenluma.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.p@greenluma.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC blocked by connector schema mismatch — can we extend trial/top-up?

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and the log. Sorry you're blocked.

We absolutely want to keep the demo on track. I can escalate for a one-time credit top-up and a two-week extension. To speed approval, could you confirm: (1) how many token credits you expect to consume during the extension (ballpark), and (2) whether you need the top-up applied to the hosted account or to a Dedicated sandbox?

I'm looping in David (Solutions Eng) to weigh in on the connector guidance; he may propose a short workaround so you can proceed with the demo while your engineering team lands the schema fix. I'll loop in Marissa for commercial approval.

Next steps: please reply with the estimated token need and preferred billing/sandbox target and we'll move this through.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: GreenLuma — request for credits and trial extension (GL-3921)

Marissa / David — forwarding the thread from GreenLuma (deal GL-3921). They hit an ingestion schema mismatch that's stalling their scheduled demo. Alex asked for a 2-week extension plus a one-time top-up.

Details from Alex: attached error log. They didn't give an exact token estimate in the initial note; they replied separately and asked for guidance, but we should propose something. My recommendation: approve up to 200k token credits (hosted) and extend the trial by 14 days. Condition: ask them to run the workaround David suggests and confirm the demo date within the extension period.

David — can you review the attached log and propose a short workaround (shim or transform) they can apply so they can proceed with validation immediately? If it looks like a larger engineering lift, flag it and we can tighten the credit request.

Marissa — can you confirm commercial OK (one-time top-up, not recurring) and I'll finalize the customer note once approved.

Thanks — Neha
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: GreenLuma — request for credits and trial extension (GL-3921)

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the connector log — the payload is sending an array where we expect an object due to a versioned schema mismatch (likely their producer library). Short-term workaround: a lightweight ingestion shim (1) detect top-level array and wrap as object with an events field, and (2) map legacy event fields to the current schema. I can produce a 20-line node script they can drop into the adapter; it should let them run the demo within an hour and avoid token waste.

If they prefer, we can also enable a temporary permissive parser on the sandbox, but that increases surface area; I'd rather they run the shim.

Approve the suggested commercial side if we're ok with 200k tokens — that gives them capacity for heavy validation and keeps the cost bounded.

—David
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@greenluma.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.p@greenluma.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC blocked by connector schema mismatch — can we extend trial/top-up?

Hi Alex — good news. We approved a one-time hosted credit top-up of 200,000 token credits and extended your trial window by 14 calendar days (new trial end: 2027-03-03). Attached is the authorization PDF for bookkeeping.

David attached a small shim that you can drop into your adapter; if you want, we can hop on a 30-minute pairing session tomorrow to help run it and validate the demo sequence. Please confirm your preferred demo date during the extension window and whether you want the shim applied on your side or for us to stage it in the dedicated sandbox.

Conditions: this is a single, non-recurring credit grant tied to GL-3921 demo completion. If additional capacity is required after the extension, we'll transition to a paid pilot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you back on track.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: trial-topup-authorization.pdf (pdf), connector-error-log.txt (text)
